data.title: Motorised dermabrader
data.summary: Dermabrasion & resurfacing · Motor-driven handpiece that spins diamond fraises or wire brushes to abrade skin at controlled speed.
data.body:
![Motorised dermabrader](instruments/motorized-dermabrader.jpg)

_Also called: Micromotor, Hand engine, Dermabrasion machine, Diamond fraise, Wire brush_

Motor-driven handpiece that spins diamond fraises or wire brushes to abrade skin at controlled speed.

## Parts
- Motor / control unit with foot pedal
- Rotating handpiece
- Attachments: diamond fraise or wire brush

## Types / variants
- Diamond fraises - diamond chips bonded to steel wheels; regular, coarse, extra-coarse (coarser = deeper)
- Wire brushes - short steel wires; abrade deeper than fraises
- Burrs of various shapes (ball, pear, cylinder, cone, wheel)
- Bell hand engines, dental burrs

## Uses / indications
- Same indications as manual dermabrasion (vitiligo recipient site, scars, rhinophyma, amyloidosis)
- Driving FUE punches in hair transplant
- Bone/nail burring (osteophyte removal) - seminar

## Method of use
1. Choose fraise/brush by depth needed
2. Set speed; depth depends on burr type, speed, pressure, duration and skin condition

## Sterilisation & care
Fraises/brushes: autoclave; handpiece per manufacturer

## Viva points & tips
- Speed: Khopkar 3000-30,000 rpm (seminar text garbled as '3,000 and 0,000 rpm')
- Wire brush abrades deeper than diamond fraise
